---
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    scrolling: true
---

```{r}
#| message: FALSE
library(flowCore)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)
library(data.table)
library(tidyr)
library(Luciernaga)
library(gt)


Computer <- getwd()
MainFolder <- file.path(Computer, "data")
TheList <- "Discover S8"
DetectorData <- read.csv(list.files(file.path(MainFolder,TheList,"Archive"), pattern = "Detector", full.names = T), check.names = F)
ImgData <- read.csv(list.files(file.path(MainFolder,TheList,"Archive"), pattern = "Imaging", full.names = T), check.names = F)

```

```{r}
TheDate <- DetectorData %>% slice(1) %>% pull(DateTime) %>% as.Date(.)
```

```{r}
WindowOfInterest <- Sys.time() - months(24)

Det_Data <- DetectorData %>% dplyr::filter(DateTime >= WindowOfInterest)
Img_Data <- ImgData %>% dplyr::filter(DateTime >= WindowOfInterest)
```

```{r}
RepairData <- read.csv("AuroraMaintenance.csv", check.names=FALSE)

RepairData <- RepairData %>% dplyr::filter(!str_detect(reason, "lean"))

RepairData <- RepairData %>% dplyr::filter(instrument %in% "Discover S8")
Maintenance <- RepairData
```

```{r}
MFIData <- Det_Data[,str_detect(colnames(Det_Data), "MFI")] %>% slice(1)
MFITable <- tidyr::pivot_longer(MFIData, cols = 1:86 ,names_to="Detector", values_to="MFI")
MFITable$Detector <- substring(MFITable$Detector,first=8)
RCVData <-  Det_Data[,str_detect(colnames(Det_Data), "rCV")] %>% slice(1)
RCVTable <- tidyr::pivot_longer(RCVData, cols = 1:86 ,names_to="Detector", values_to="rCV")
RCVTable$Detector <- substring(RCVTable$Detector,first=6)

IntermediateTable <- bind_cols(MFITable, RCVTable[,2])
TableDate <- TheDate
DailyTable <- IntermediateTable %>% gt() %>% tab_header(title = TableDate) %>%
                                      data_color(columns = rCV, 
                                                        fn = function(x) {
                                                          dplyr::case_when(x < 15 ~ "#0B6623", x >= 15 ~ 
                                                                             "#C80815", TRUE ~ NA_character_)
                                                        }) %>%
                                      data_color(columns = MFI, palette = "gray"
                                                        )
```

```{r}
x <- Det_Data
TheColumns <- x %>% select(where(~is.numeric(.)||is.integer(.))) %>% colnames()
TheColumns <- setdiff(TheColumns, "TIME")

# MFIs
TheIntermediate <- TheColumns[!str_detect(TheColumns, "Gain")]
TheIntermediate <- TheIntermediate[!str_detect(TheIntermediate, "rCV")]
TheColumnNames <- TheIntermediate[str_detect(TheIntermediate, "-A")]

 UVGains <- TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheColumnNames, "_UV")]  
    VioletGains <- TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheColumnNames, "_V")] 
    BlueGains <- TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheColumnNames, "_B")] 
    YellowGreenGains <- TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheColumnNames, "_YG")] 
    RedGains <- TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheColumnNames, "_R")] 
    ImgGains <- TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheColumnNames, "_Img")]

ScatterGains <- c(TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheIntermediate, "SC")],TheColumnNames[str_detect(TheIntermediate, "LightLoss")])
ScatterGains <- ScatterGains[!is.na(ScatterGains)]
LaserGains <- TheIntermediate[str_detect(TheIntermediate, "delay")]

ScalingGains <- TheIntermediate[str_detect(TheIntermediate, "Scaling")]
ScalingGains <- Luciernaga:::ColorPriority(ScalingGains)
OtherGains <- c(ScatterGains, LaserGains, ScalingGains)

UVPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=UVGains,
                      plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                      Metadata="NULL", strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = "MFI",
                      RepairVisits=RepairData)

VioletPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=VioletGains,
                      plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                      Metadata="NULL", strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = "MFI",
                      RepairVisits=RepairData)

BluePlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=BlueGains,
                      plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                      Metadata=NULL, strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = "MFI",
                      RepairVisits=RepairData)

YellowGreenPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=YellowGreenGains,
                     plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                     Metadata=NULL, strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = "MFI",
                     RepairVisits=RepairData)                      

RedPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=RedGains,
                     plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                     Metadata=NULL, strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = "MFI",
                     RepairVisits=RepairData)

ImgPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=ImgGains,
                     plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                     Metadata=NULL, strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = "MFI",
                     RepairVisits=RepairData)

ScatterPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=ScatterGains,
                     plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                     Metadata=NULL, strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = " ",
                     RepairVisits=RepairData)

LaserPlotsMFI <- QC_Plots(x=x, FailedFlag=FALSE, MeasurementType=LaserGains,
                     plotType = "individual", returntype = "plots",
                     Metadata=NULL, strict = TRUE, YAxisLabel = " ",
                     RepairVisits=RepairData)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: false
PDFPlots <- c(UVPlotsMFI, VioletPlotsMFI, BluePlotsMFI, YellowGreenPlotsMFI, RedPlotsMFI, ScatterPlotsMFI, UVPlotsGain, VioletPlotsGain, BluePlotsGain, YellowGreenPlotsGain, RedPlotsGain, ScatterPlotsGain, UVPlotsRCV, VioletPlotsRCV, BluePlotsRCV, YellowGreenPlotsRCV, RedPlotsRCV, ScatterPlotsRCV)

Filename <- paste0("QCPlots_Discover S8")

PDF <- Utility_Patchwork(x=PDFPlots, filename=Filename, returntype="pdf", outfolder=MainFolder, thecolumns=1)
```

## {.sidebar}
Dashboard data for the **BD Discover S8** last updated on **`r TheDate`**

**First Column: MFI** Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) values for the QC beads. Measures stability over time. 

**Second Column: Gain** Gain (Voltage) values set for instrument after QC. Changes over time reflective of laser health. 

**Third Colum: RCV** Percentage change of Robust Coefficient Variation (RCV) after QC. Higher values reflect decreased resolution between positive and negative for that detector.

For additional information concerning individual parameter tabs, navigate to the [Help](https://umgccfcss.github.io/InstrumentQC/help) page.

**About**

This dashboard contains the visualized QC data for the Cytek and BD cytometers at the [FHCC Flow Core](https://www.fredhutch.org/en/research/shared-resources/core-facilities/flow-cytometry.html)

For additional flow cytometry resources, visit our [website](https://extranet.fredhutch.org/u/shared-resources/training-and-educational-materials/flow-cytometry.html)

This dashboard was created with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and is maintained by [Nate Colven](https://github.com/ncolven). It was adapted from [David Rach's](https://github.com/DavidRach) work at UMGCC.
